name: List meeting recordings
description: Lists cloud recording metadata for Microsoft Teams meetings you organized, including Meet Now meetings, without downloading video files. Optionally filter to a single meeting by join URL, meetingRecap URL, or conference ID. Graph can list recordings for meetings you attended; this action only returns ones you organized, because only the organizer can download the MP4.

inputFields.label: Meeting join URL, recap URL, or conference ID
inputFields.description: The Teams meeting join URL, meetingRecap URL, or the conference ID (e.g. '398 774 104 902 21'). When set, only recordings for that meeting are listed. Leave empty to list recent recordings across meetings you organized. Join URL looks up the online meeting. Conference ID and recap URL look up calendar events in the past year and future 90 days as fallback.

inputFields.label: Occurrence date
inputFields.description: Return recordings for the meeting occurrence on this date (YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. '2025-01-15'). Only applied when a meeting identifier is provided. If no recording exists for the exact date, the closest available recording is returned with a notice.

inputFields.label: Limit
inputFields.description: Maximum number of recordings to return, newest first. Defaults to 20. Capped at 50.
